Use the keypad to enter numbers and operators. Tap = to compute. Use the history icon for past calculations and the arrows icon to show scientific functions.

• Basic calculator: Tap numbers and operators (+, −, ×, ÷). Tap = for the result. Use AC to clear, ( ) for parentheses.

• Scientific mode: Tap "Scientific mode" above the keypad to show extra keys (√, π, sin, cos, tan, etc.).

• History: Past calculations appear in the list. Tap "Use" on any item to load it and edit or continue.

• Modes: Open the menu (☰) to switch to Temperature, EMI, Interest, Currency, or Date Calculator.

• Theme: Use the 3-dot menu → Choose theme for Light, Dark, or System default.
Share your feedback or report an issue. Your message will be sent to the developer.
We use feedback like yours to fix issues and improve the app.

Nur's Custom Calculator respects your privacy.

• This app does not collect personal data. Calculations are performed on your device only.

• History is stored locally on your device and is not sent to any server.

• If you contact us via Send feedback, we receive only the email content you choose to send (e.g. to mollanuramin130@gmail.com) to respond to your request.

• We do not use analytics or third-party tracking in this app.

• For questions about this policy, email mollanuramin130@gmail.com.
